blocks.text: Desmond Bane and Franz Wagner combined for 45 points and Orlando upset Boston, 115-105, which allowed Philadelphia to take over the No. 1 ranking from the Celtics in the Eastern Conference in the NBA on Monday. Bane led the Magic with 24 points, while the in-form Wagner finished with 21 points and nine assists as Orlando snapped the Celtics’ six-game winning streak, even as the Sixers scored a 135-123 win over the Brooklyn Nets.
